law: TAKE HER ON THE JAUNT SO SHE SEES. FILL THE INNER OF HER FAN AS SHE GOES. THIS IS WHAT THE INSIDE LOOKS LIKE. PAINT IT BROWN AND GREEN ON THE FACE INSIDE HER. LOOK FOR YELLOWSTONE AND THE ROCKY MOUNTAINS. MICHIGAN IS HOME STATE. CITY IS LANSING. biomeOS IS A MAP. THE RSS SHE ALREADY HOLDS IS THE EAT.
face: brown and green. painted on the face inside her.
